opportunities.name: Gravel Running Shoes
opportunities.subtitle: Trail-road crossover capsule

explainability.why_trending: Search and specialist media signals are rising across US and UK trail-running communities.
explainability.why_fits_switzerland: It bridges hiking, trail running and fast day tours, all highly relevant Swiss outdoor use cases.
explainability.why_opportunity_now: Swiss premium shelves show limited coverage, creating a first-mover capsule opportunity.

risks.name: Supplier access
risks.mitigation: Start with brands already distributing in EU/DACH and negotiate small test quantities.

risks.name: Category label may not stick
risks.mitigation: Merchandise as trail-road crossover rather than relying only on the gravel label.

monitor_triggers: Google Trends CH declines for 3 consecutive months
Bächli or Transa add equivalent SKUs

opportunities.name: Fastpacking Vest Packs
opportunities.subtitle: Hybrid trail-running and hiking packs

explainability.why_trending: Fastpacking appears across trail communities, ultralight forums and retailer assortments.
explainability.why_fits_switzerland: Swiss day tours and hut-to-hut routes reward light, fast and compact carrying systems.
explainability.why_opportunity_now: The category exists locally but remains under-merchandised as a dedicated use case.

risks.name: Retail saturation
risks.mitigation: Differentiate with curated premium models rather than generic running vests.

risks.name: Fit complexity
risks.mitigation: Test in-store fitting guidance and size range before scaling.

monitor_triggers: Competitors launch dedicated fastpacking landing pages
Returns due to fit exceed normal pack benchmark

opportunities.name: Alpha Direct Midlayers
opportunities.subtitle: Breathable active-insulation layer

explainability.why_trending: Ultralight and hiking communities continue to discuss active insulation and breathable fleece systems.
explainability.why_fits_switzerland: The product fits shoulder-season alpine activity but needs strong technical education.
explainability.why_opportunity_now: Some availability already exists, so the stronger play is supplier conversation and margin validation.

risks.name: Margin proof missing
risks.mitigation: Monitor pricing and sell-through before committing to broad assortment.

risks.name: Product education
risks.mitigation: Use staff and content education to explain warmth-versus-breathability tradeoff.

monitor_triggers: More DACH retailers add house-brand alternatives
Price compression below premium margin target
Review sentiment shifts to durability concerns

opportunities.name: Mycelium Bio-Synthetic Membranes
opportunities.subtitle: Directional material signal

explainability.why_trending: Sustainability and material innovation articles mention mycelium and bio-synthetic performance textiles.
explainability.why_fits_switzerland: Sustainability resonates with Swiss outdoor buyers, but commercial outdoor SKUs are not yet mature.
explainability.why_opportunity_now: This is a watch item only: buzz exists, but there is not enough orderable product evidence.

risks.name: No retail SKU proof
risks.mitigation: Do not buy inventory; track supplier launches and trade-show proof.

risks.name: Performance uncertainty
risks.mitigation: Require waterproofness and durability validation before supplier contact.

monitor_triggers: Material is used by a recognized outdoor brand
Independent lab or review evidence confirms performance

opportunities.name: Cargo Bikepacking Bags
opportunities.subtitle: Urban-weekend modular bag system

explainability.why_trending: Cargo and utility bike communities are combining commuting and weekend micro-adventure gear.
explainability.why_fits_switzerland: Swiss urban cycling and weekend outdoor habits make modular bags a credible crossover.
explainability.why_opportunity_now: Boutique cycling shelves are not yet saturated, leaving room for curated modular systems.

risks.name: Niche use case
risks.mitigation: Start with modular bestsellers and show use-case bundles.

risks.name: Price sensitivity
risks.mitigation: Offer one premium and one mid-price option.

monitor_triggers: Veloplus or Galaxus launch similar bundles
Social interest stays urban-only with no outdoor crossover
Supplier lead times exceed seasonal window
